description: Peek up to `count` samples from a recorded bag file as a `SampleResult`: offline, for post-mortem (`peek_dds_samples` and `sample_messages` are live). Formats, by extension: MCAP (`.mcap`), rosbag2 SQLite (`.db3`), ROS 1 (`.bag`). Returns the **first** `count` messages of the topic in recording order, not the last (`sample_messages` keeps the newest log matches). `start_s` / `end_s` limit it to a bag-relative time range, empty with a `note` past the end; on `/rosout`, `min_log_level` and `node` keep the first `count` matching logs in range. **Clocks**: `timestamp_ns` is `header.stamp` when the message has a top-level header (`stamp_source` `header`), else the time in the body of `Clock`, `TFMessage` or `Log` (`payload`), else the bag record time (`recorded`); `recorded_ns` is always the record time. Each `payload` carries `_decode_status` (`full` / `partial` / `raw`). `count` defaults to 5, clamped to 50. **Uses the `rosbags` library** and needs the ROS 2 side of the runtime (an error on a DDS-only setup). Mock returns fixtures on canned paths. A bag without embedded definitions (Humble `.db3`) is decoded with those of its recorded distro, or Humble; `note` says which. Arrays over 4096 elements are cut and `note` lists them. **Read-only by architecture**. **Raises an MCP error** when the path does not exist, the topic is not in the bag, or `rosbags` is missing. **Summary and rate**: `LaserScan`, `Odometry`, `Imu`, `Image` and `PointCloud2` samples carry a `summary` of the whole message (other types: null); `rate` gives frequency, interval spread and a `verdict` measured on `recorded_ns` (the bag record time of the returned messages). Use `count` >= 10 (50 above 20 Hz); a multi-publisher topic such as `/tf` reads `erratic` without being broken. **Duration**: takes no lock (in-process file read, so it runs while a ROS 2 or DDS call is busy); the time follows the bag's size and how deep the first samples are.

count.description: Messages to return, default 5, at most 50 (`health_check.max_sample_count`): more is capped to 50, negative raises an error. The result's `count` may be lower.

end_s.description: Only messages recorded before this bag-relative second (exclusive), default to the end.

min_log_level.description: `/rosout` (`rcl_interfaces/msg/Log`) only: keep messages at or above this level (debug 10, info 20, warn 30, error 40, fatal 50). Other topics: error.

node.description: `/rosout` only: keep logs of this node and its child loggers, e.g. `/robot1/driver` (also `driver`, `robot1.driver`). Exact name, never a prefix. Other topics: error.

path.description: Bag path: a `.mcap` or `.db3` file or a `rosbag2_*` directory (`peek_bag_samples` also reads ROS 1 `.bag`; `analyze_bag` does not). Existence and format are checked live; mock accepts any well-formed path.

start_s.description: Only messages recorded at or after this many seconds from the bag's first message (`analyze_bag.start_ns`), default from the start.

topic.description: Fully qualified ROS 2 topic name starting with `/`, e.g. `/cmd_vel`. Segments are letters, digits and underscores (not starting with a digit); anything else is rejected before reaching the `ros2` CLI.

name: peek_bag_samples

payload.description: Message fields as nested values; `nan`/`inf` are strings. Live `sample_messages` adds `_truncated_fields` (cut paths) and `_raw_text` (unparsable output).

received_ns.description: Wall-clock ns when the `ros2` CLI printed the message (live `sample_messages` only).

recorded_ns.description: Bag record time in ns (`peek_bag_samples` only).

summary.description: Condensed reading of the whole message (see `summary_type`); `null` for other types and DDS peeks.

timestamp_ns.description: Publisher-clock ns: `header.stamp`, else the time in the body of `Clock`, `TFMessage` or `Log`, else 0 (see `stamp_source`); not the arrival time.

basis.description: Clock the rate is measured on: `received_ns` (live) or `recorded_ns` (bag).

clock_basis.description: Stamp clock: `wall` (stamps are dates), `sim` (since a start), `none` (no stamps), `mixed` (several kinds, e.g. two publishers).

interval_cv.description: Interval standard deviation over mean; `null` under 2 messages.

message_count.description: Messages the rate is computed from.

observed_frequency_hz.description: Messages per second on `basis`, drain excluded; the rate the caller received. `null` under 2 messages.

sim_frequency_hz.description: Same rate on the messages' own stamps (publisher clock); `null` without advancing stamps.

stamp_age_median_s.description: Median of arrival minus stamp, s, if `wall`; negative = publisher ahead.

stamp_age_p95_s.description: 95th percentile of that age (max under 20 messages).

stamp_regression_count.description: Times a stamp went back versus the previous one.

startup_burst_count.description: Leading messages set aside as a start-up drain (live only); still in `message_count`.

trailing_gap_s.description: Time from the last message to the end of a live observation; else `null`.

verdict.description: First match: `silent` (none), `insufficient` (under 5), `intermittent` (an interval over 3x the median), `stable` (cv < 0.2), `jittery` (< 0.5), `erratic`. Describes this window, not a diagnosis.

count.description: Number of samples in `samples`: fewer than requested when the topic gave fewer, never more than 50 (a larger request is capped to 50).

note.description: Why `samples` is empty or limited, when not obvious; else `None`.

rate.description: How the topic delivered the messages, with a verdict; `null` for `peek_dds_samples`. Use `count` >= 10.

title: Peek bag samples
